rationale: The agent looked up the user and orders (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details, get_order_details) and fetched product details, but there is no evidence it fulfilled the user’s multi-step request. It did not provide the price and battery life of the purchased Bluetooth speaker, did not process or even seek confirmation for canceling the speaker if over $300, did not identify sub-$100 alternatives or add the cheapest one, and did not confirm a revised “new order” total. The only surfaced outcome is reporting the total for the current pending order (#W5061109), which does not reflect any requested modifications. Thus the agent did not complete the request per policy requirements (performing changes with confirmation and providing correct final information).
